body:
XL original-model progress — 13 October 2026, checkpoint v8

Fixed scope: 521 XL originals; 234 installed in the catalogue / 287 remaining. One new installation since v7. Prior 232 exact current review bindings are preserved, plus Nam Fung; West Wing 26195 remains an installed legacy compound-acceptance follow-up. All 287 absent originals remain in the active goal.

Nam Fung Court 79099 is installed and pushed in commit 71daf44c89cc37782fff65aa2c598c4bd1bd2497. Original government source 7ca5a8202c6903f0e765d4586bcbd7597a009b8a997528431c4ed3e2963362fb is unchanged: 13,061 faces, 569 components, fixed 1× source pose. Exact BASIC45779 support stays visible (432 fallback faces); its held government podium is not installed or suppressed. Completed qualification job a335eccd… bound 7,904 verified references. ROOT inspected all eight staged/live desktop/mobile day/night exports; picking, collision, full framing, support availability and failed-download fallback/retry passed. Installed job 31f7ef1661482a8c9d79afa0ba713e9c4e68e7b0d3508ae26300cb87b8bf4d1d and count job 8f2ec715499a5571fc13b679b4b23439826fafe13c6e0fffa6f23d107ce42ad8 were independently read back from pinned Neon. Snapshot 5cb980a97466802b; reservations released. Only one catalogue appended; all prior 6,649 native entries and terrain remain unchanged.

Whole-map counts: 346,108 source forms; 4,517 enhanced (4,499 government + 18 other); 212,669 government-eligible forms; 6,650 native catalogue entries. These are source/model forms, not unique physical buildings.

Remaining active recovery:
- Upton: completed job 7fec849f… verified all 8,616 references; reservations released. Whole-facet protection conflicts with 127 original main-podium faces, only through two oversized base-terrain triangles. Native parent protection at the missing sample is unchanged and has no saved ordinary conflict. A bounded complete-mask Float32 enclosure repair is drafted; no new constructor started.
- Southside: completed saved-piece diagnostic e0e2d93a… verified all 8,213 references. Full 16-form restoration conflicts with three independent forms; all 1,560 negative records retained. Source-only selective 13-form preparation proves all 3,653 closed domain primitives and exact Mall50/Station20 parent correspondence. The entire transition collar still needs qualification; this is not terrain or model acceptance.
- Next source-interface lead: Citywalk134332 retains passed historical original identity/foundation; investigate genuine interfaces with existing native175935/273839/305615 before any new current qualification. China Merchants264206 needs actual buried-facet/source-role attribution.

Original government geometry remains immutable. Zero AI geometry modelling. This acquisition run has no optimisation processing, variant approval or derived-asset publication; other optimisation work remains separate. Future physical checks must bind the honest new Nam/current scene, reusing unchanged evidence by exact bytes rather than rerunning old captures or treating historical records as current approvals. Installed catalogue flags alone are not authoritative: reconcile exact Neon/source/placement evidence and preserve genuine holds.
